release_notes: Keitaro migration keeps far more stream filters. "@empty" in the Language filter now means the browser sent no language, as in Keitaro; streams already imported with a bare "empty" start working after the update without a re-import. The importer maps source (to Parameter source), ISP, User-Agent, referrer, empty referrer, keyword, OS, browser, IP, connection type and operator instead of dropping them; search engine filters become a Referer filter and are reported as approximate. New User-Agent stream filter, an Empty checkbox on Language, Referer and User-Agent, * masks and /regex/ in Referer and User-Agent, CIDR and a-b ranges in the IP filter. Affiliate network template MapGroup.
